SELECT a.*, c.NAME as name,c.ID_NUMBER as idNumber,c.DEPT as dept,c.DUTY as duty, c.HIRE_DATE as hireDate,c.POSITIVE_TIME as positiveTime,c.TRIAL_PERIOD as trialPeriod, c.CONTRACT_UNIT as contractUnit,c.HIGHEST_EDUCATION as highestEducation, c.GRADUATE_SCHOOL as graduateSchool,c.MAJOR as major, b.SN as dutySn,b.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID as dutyProcessInstanceId,b.APPLY_TYPE as applyType FROM HR_TRY_TURN a left join HR_TRY_DUTY b on a.HR_TRY_DUTY_ID = b.ID left join PERSONNEL c on b.PERSONNEL_ID = c.ID where a.ID = #{id}
